decisions.reason: The source reiterates the existing self-service editing and export purpose, but does not change the candidate's already-established export capability or workflow.
Adding logos, colour codes, and other design assets to the package does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable or their formatting.
The Canva-template requirement is already fully represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event; the asset-package contents add no further change to its format, editability, or variants.
The final-PDF requirement is already fully represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event; the asset-package modification does not alter the required PDF outputs.
Requesting the missing Canva templates, PDFs, and design assets does not state that the already delivered Word documents are withdrawn or changed.
The source preserves the existing DX17–DX20 variant set and does not change its codes, editability, or risk-based selection rule.
The asset-package contents do not change the coverage, presentation, or required information of internal page headers.
The source does not alter the scoring-summary table, its format, or its required fields.
Supplying reusable design assets supports future editing but does not change the established visual standard, reference, or cross-variant theme.
The package-content change does not modify the front-page result drivers, their bullet format, or their level of detail.
The source does not change the front-page result fields, score heading, prominence, spacing, or visibility.
The added package assets do not change the required footer presence, content, or page coverage.
